classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: Target hotspot residues are not provided; BindCraft will perform global surface sampling across the full target chain A interface.
Binder length is fixed at the default 60 residues, sufficient for a compact binder against most globular targets.
Two trajectory shards (seed=0 and seed=1) maximise sequence diversity within a two-candidate budget; each shard targets one final design.
BindCraft emits a best-design complex PDB and a corresponding PAE JSON per shard; chain A is the target and chain B is the designed binder in the output complex.
filter_mode=default applies standard BindCraft pLDDT/PAE thresholds; a shard that produces no passing design is a valid null result and will be absent from ranking.
ipSAE is evaluated on each best-design complex to provide an independent interface-confidence score complementary to BindCraft's internal metrics.
rank_designs aggregates BindCraft design metrics and ipSAE scores; the ranked table is the artefact reviewed before any submission decision is made.
submit_candidate is intentionally excluded from this plan; submission is a post-round decision made after inspecting actual ranked outputs.
plan.goal: Design 1-2 compact binder candidates against the provided target structure using BindCraft (two seed shards), score interface confidence with ipSAE on each best-design complex, and aggregate outputs into a ranked candidate table for review.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: path to the target structure (.pdb file) — required by BindCraft and has no default; workflow cannot execute without it
